credits: Painted West Meadow by PIXEL: original AI-generated artwork made for High Harvest in the style of the owner-approved painted Build 3 farm; the track reuses the farm plate's painted path. Sources and scripts in scripts/art/ (compose_meadow_plate.py, process_meadow_sprites.py). No third-party assets. Spec: docs/world-art/inventory-and-plan.md. Painted Greygum Gully by PIXEL, the same way: original AI-generated floor, bush, gully view and props (scripts/art/compose_gully_plate.py, process_gully_sprites.py); gums, granite and logs reuse the shared painted farm/meadow art. The farm-side gate correction (farm-west-gate.webp, compose_west_gate_patch.py) is a masked overlay built from the farm plate's own grass and the meadow track; the farm plate file is unchanged. Painted Banksia Bend by PIXEL, the same way: original AI-generated town plate and props; posts and bunting are drawn in code (scripts/art/compose_town_plate.py, process_town_sprites.py); sign, mural and chalkboard lettering is drawn in code (compose_town_signs.py, DejaVu Sans, Bitstream Vera licence); its gums reuse the shared painted farm gums.
